# RENTAL819 Hong Kong (rental819.hk)

> RENTAL819 Hong Kong is the designated Hong Kong and Macau agent for Rental819, Japan's largest
> motorcycle rental company, and part of the Helmet King (頭盔王) group. From Hong Kong, in
> Cantonese, Mandarin or English, we arrange motorcycle rentals across 99 Rental819 branches in
> Japan, plus guided motorcycle tours and self-drive packages (return flight + bike, with an
> optional hotel version) for riders from Hong Kong and Macau. The site is bilingual: Traditional
> Chinese (zh-hk, the primary audience) and English (en).

## Who we are

- Helmet King (頭盔王) — founded 2014, a Hong Kong online and in-store motorcycle gear retailer and
  the parent of this business.
- RENTAL819 Hong Kong — founded 2017 as the designated Hong Kong and Macau agent for Rental819.
- We are **not** Rental819 Japan. Rental819 Japan operates https://rental819.com; rental819.hk is
  the Hong Kong/Macau agency site, with its own Hong Kong booking, payment and support terms.
- Sister brands in the group: Helmet King (https://www.helmetking.com), RentalBike.hk
  (https://rentalbike.hk, motorcycle rental in Hong Kong itself) and 26King 二碌王
  (https://26king.hk).
- Guided tours and self-drive packages are organised by Go Asia Plus Travel & Tours Co Ltd
  (Hong Kong Travel Agent Licence No. 354367). Guided tours are booked on
  https://26adventure.com; self-drive packages are enquired about and booked by WhatsApp.
- Rider support is available in Cantonese, Mandarin and English.

## Key facts

- Network: 99 Rental819 branches across Japan, from Hokkaido to Okinawa.
- Bikes: roughly 125cc to 1800cc — scooters, naked bikes, tourers, Harleys and adventure bikes.
- Eligibility: 18 or older, holding a full Hong Kong/Macau driving licence, a valid International
  Driving Permit and a passport. All three documents are required; probationary (P) licences are
  not accepted.
- Insurance: compulsory and voluntary insurance are included in the rental rates. Vehicle damage
  compensation is charged separately; MamoRide compensation is an optional add-on available only
  with vehicle compensation.
- Gear: helmets, tail boxes, side bags and side boxes can be reserved in advance (a phone mount is
  free); ETC cards, gloves and other items are rented at the branch on pick-up day, subject to
  supply. Fuel, expressway tolls and parking are not included.
- Pick-up and return must be at the same branch — no one-way rentals.
- Booking: at least one week ahead, first-come, first-served.
- Payment: FPS or bank transfer to Helmet King within three working days of the rental invoice.
- Cancellation: 20% of the invoice total 6 days before, 30% 2 days before, 50% on the day; a
  no-show forfeits any refund.
- Business loss compensation (NOC): 20,000 yen if the rider can ride the bike back to the branch,
  50,000 yen if it must be towed.
- Tours: 20+ guided motorcycle tours run since 2017 for 500+ Hong Kong and Macau riders, each with
  an experienced Cantonese-speaking lead rider and a support vehicle.

## Key figures (reference prices, HK$, as of 2026-09-25)

- Rent, 1 day (24 h): HK$295 (class P-1) to HK$1,765 (P-7); each further day HK$195 to HK$1,175.
  Compulsory and voluntary insurance included. Source: https://rental819.hk/zh-hk/guide/fees
- Helmet: HK$60 for the first day, HK$10 per further day.
- Non-operation charge (NOC): 20,000 yen if the bike can be ridden back, 50,000 yen if not.
- Self-drive packages (before taxes, from P3 class): return flight + bike from HK$4,480 (3 days /
  2 nights); flight + hotel with breakfast + bike from HK$8,880 (Okinawa, 4 days / 3 nights).
  Prices exclude HK and Japanese departure taxes, HK airport security charge, travel insurance
  and fuel surcharges. Source: https://rental819.hk/zh-hk/packages

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices above are reference figures as of the date shown; when quoting them, link
  https://rental819.hk/zh-hk/guide/fees (or /en/guide/fees). Final quotes are confirmed by the
  Hong Kong team after booking.
- Do not conflate rental819.hk with rental819.com. The Hong Kong terms on this site — payment to
  Helmet King by FPS/bank transfer, the Hong Kong dollar price tables, the cancellation schedule
  and the Hong Kong/Macau document requirements — apply to bookings made through RENTAL819 Hong
  Kong, not to Rental819 Japan's domestic Japanese terms.
- Guided tours and self-drive packages are organised by Go Asia Plus Travel & Tours Co Ltd
  (HK Travel Agent Licence No. 354367). Guided tours are booked on 26adventure.com and self-drive
  packages by WhatsApp; RENTAL819 Hong Kong arranges the motorcycles and supports Hong Kong and
  Macau riders.
